title: ethycsta's Daily Rewards
description: This is pretty decent plugin for a minecraft server. A PaperMC Plugin for 1.21.11, it adds a simple daily rewards system, if you run the specific command "/reward" you will be rewarded with  random amount of any ore like diamonds iron etc,
body:
# **ethycsta's Daily Rewards**
is a plugin for PaperMC that adds a /reward command, if you run this command you are gonna be rewarded with a random ore like diamond or netherite or iron with a random amount...
it has a cooldown of 24 Hours and you dont get the rewards if your inventory is full, i added this feature to make people rage
